title: Judge explanation
description: What the LLM of the Judge returns for one regressed metric. The rules decide the verdict and the metric; the model repeats both and explains the cause from the data it gets.

verdict.description: The verdict of the rules, repeated: fail when the gate failed, pass otherwise

metric.description: The metric to explain, repeated from the rules, or none when nothing regressed

suspected_cause.description: The change of the branch that most likely caused the regression of that metric, in one sentence

evidence.description: Facts from the input that support the cause: a line of the diff, a function of a trace, a metric

confidence.description: How well the evidence supports the cause
